sloka: कच्चित् स्त्रिय: सान्त्वयसि कच्चित्ताश्च सुरक्षिता: ।कच्चिन्न श्रद्दधास्यासां कच्चिद् गुह्यं न भाषसे ॥ २.१००.५०॥
transliteration: kaccit striya: sāntvayasi kaccittāśca surakṣitā: ।kaccinna śraddadhāsyāsāṁ kaccid guhyaṁ na bhāṣase ॥ 2.100.50॥

translations.english: I trust, you protect the habitat of elephants and you have a large number of milch cows. I trust you are not contented with the existing number of female and male elephants and horses.
